name: 马克西米连·罗伯斯庇尔

points.title: 早年教育
points.description: 罗伯斯庇尔1758年5月6日出生于法国北部城市阿拉斯的一个律师家庭。他的母亲早逝，父亲离开家庭后，由亲戚抚养长大。在路易大帝学院接受教育期间，他展现出卓越的才华和对古典文学的热爱。1775年，他获得奖学金进入巴黎路易大帝学院学习法律，期间深受启蒙思想家卢梭和孟德斯鸠的影响，形成了自己的政治理念。这段教育经历为他后来的政治生涯奠定了思想基础，培养了他对正义和共和制度的坚定信念。
points.descriptionEn: Born in Arras to a family of lawyers, Robespierre's mother died when he was young and his father abandoned the family. He was raised by relatives. At the College of Louis-le-Grand in Paris, where he studied on scholarship from 1775, he excelled academically and developed a deep appreciation for classical literature. During this period, he was profoundly influenced by Enlightenment thinkers like Rousseau and Montesquieu, which shaped his political philosophy. This educational foundation established his lifelong commitment to justice and republican ideals.

points.title: 律师生涯
points.description: 1781年，罗伯斯庇尔获得律师资格后回到家乡阿拉斯执业。作为一名律师，他积极为贫困阶层辩护，反对特权阶级的不公正行为。1783年，他当选为阿拉斯科学院院士，开始发表政治和社会评论文章。1788年，他发表了《致国人书》，呼吁召开三级会议，改革法国政治制度。这段律师经历使他深入了解社会不公，培养了他为弱势群体辩护的立场，为他后来在法国大革命中的激进政治立场奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: After qualifying as a lawyer in 1781, Robespierre returned to Arras to practice law. As an attorney, he actively defended the poor and opposed the injustices committed by the privileged classes. In 1783, he was elected to the Arras Academy of Sciences and began publishing political and social commentary. In 1788, he published his 'Address to the Nation,' calling for the convening of the Estates-General and reform of France's political system. This legal career allowed him to gain deep insight into social injustices and develop his advocacy for the disadvantaged, laying the groundwork for his later radical political stance during the French Revolution.

points.title: 革命初期
points.description: 1789年法国大革命爆发后，罗伯斯庇尔作为阿拉斯代表当选为三级会议代表，进入政治舞台。在国民议会中，他主张废除特权、建立君主立宪制，并发表了著名的《论人类不平等的起源和社会责任》演讲，受到广泛关注。1790年，他加入雅各宾俱乐部，逐渐成为该组织的核心人物。他支持《人权宣言》的通过，主张言论自由和宗教宽容。这一时期，罗伯斯庇尔确立了作为革命理论家的地位，他的共和主义思想和道德政治理念开始形成，为后来的激进政策奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: With the outbreak of the French Revolution in 1789, Robespierre was elected as a deputy for Arras to the Estates-General, entering the political stage. In the National Assembly, he advocated for the abolition of privileges and the establishment of a constitutional monarchy. He delivered his famous speech 'On the Origin of Human Inequality and Social Responsibility,' which garnered significant attention. In 1790, he joined the Jacobin Club and gradually became one of its central figures. He supported the passage of the Declaration of the Rights of Man and advocated for freedom of speech and religious tolerance. During this period, Robespierre established himself as a revolutionary theorist, developing his republican ideas and moral political philosophy that would later inform his radical policies.

points.title: 立法议会时期
points.description: 1791年，罗伯斯庇尔当选为立法议会代表，继续推动革命进程。他反对国王路易十六的逃亡行为，主张废除君主制。1792年8月，巴黎民众起义推翻君主制后，罗伯斯庇尔当选国民公会代表，成为共和派的重要领导人。在国民公会中，他坚决主张处决路易十六，认为这是维护共和国安全的必要措施。这一时期，罗伯斯庇尔的立场日益激进，他开始强调恐怖统治的必要性，认为只有通过严厉手段才能保卫革命成果。他的政治影响力不断扩大，为后来的雅各宾派专政奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Elected to the Legislative Assembly in 1791, Robespierre continued to advance the revolutionary cause. He opposed King Louis XVI's flight to Varennes and advocated for the abolition of the monarchy. Following the Parisian uprising in August 1792 that overthrew the monarchy, Robespierre was elected to the National Convention, becoming a key leader of the republican faction. In the Convention, he strongly advocated for the king's execution, arguing it was necessary to ensure the safety of the republic. During this period, Robespierre's stance became increasingly radical, as he began to emphasize the necessity of terror as a means to defend the revolution. His political influence grew significantly, laying the groundwork for the later Jacobin dictatorship.

points.title: 雅各宾派统治
points.description: 1793年6月，罗伯斯庇尔成为公共安全委员会成员，随后成为该委员会的实际领导人。在法国面临国内外危机的背景下，他推动建立了革命政府，实施恐怖统治政策。他颁布了《全面限价法》，控制物价；建立了革命法庭，迅速审判并处决了大量被认为威胁革命的人，包括政治对手、贵族和普通民众。在这一时期，约有17,000人被送上断头台。罗伯斯庇尔试图通过这些极端措施建立'美德共和国'，推行他的道德政治理念。然而，他的统治手段越来越极端，导致党内和民众的不满日益增加，为他的倒台埋下了伏笔。
points.descriptionEn: In June 1793, Robespierre became a member of the Committee of Public Safety and soon its de facto leader. Amidst France's domestic and foreign crises, he pushed for the establishment of a revolutionary government and implemented policies of terror. He promulgated the Law of General Maximum to control prices and established revolutionary tribunals that rapidly tried and executed large numbers of people deemed threats to the revolution, including political opponents, aristocrats, and ordinary citizens. During this period, approximately 17,000 people were executed by guillotine. Robespierre attempted to create a 'republic of virtue' through these extreme measures, implementing his moral political philosophy. However, his increasingly radical methods growing dissatisfaction within the party and among the populace, sowing the seeds of his downfall.

points.title: 倒台与死亡
points.description: 1794年6月，罗伯斯庇尔推动崇拜最高存在者，试图建立新的公民宗教，引起党内其他派别的不满。7月27日（热月9日），国民公会以多数票通过决议，逮捕罗伯斯庇尔及其支持者。次日，罗伯斯庇尔未经审判被送上断头台，年仅36岁。他的死亡标志着雅各宾派统治的结束和法国大革命激进阶段的终结。罗伯斯庇尔的倒台是由于他的极端政策、个人独断专行以及党内权力斗争的结果。他的死亡在法国历史上留下了复杂遗产，既被视为革命暴力的象征，也被视为理想主义政治家的悲剧。
points.descriptionEn: In June 1794, Robespierre promoted the Cult of the Supreme Being, attempting to establish a new civil religion, which displeased other factions within the party. On July 27 (Thermidor 9), the National Convention voted by a majority to arrest Robespierre and his supporters. The following day, Robespierre was guillotined without trial at the age of 36. His death marked the end of Jacobin rule and the radical phase of the French Revolution. Robespierre's downfall resulted from his extreme policies, autocratic behavior, and power struggles within the party. His death left a complex legacy in French history, viewed both as a symbol of revolutionary violence and as the tragedy of an idealistic statesman.

supporter.zh: 罗伯斯庇尔被视为法国大革命中最坚定的共和主义捍卫者，他为推翻君主专制、建立共和国做出了不可磨灭的贡献。支持者认为他的恐怖统治是保卫革命成果的必要手段，是在国家面临生死存亡关口的果断决策。他追求的'美德共和国'理念体现了对平等、自由和正义的崇高追求，对后世民主政治发展产生了深远影响。罗伯斯庇尔坚持原则、不畏强权的精神，使他成为革命理想主义的象征。
supporter.en: Robespierre is regarded as the most steadfast defender of republicanism during the French Revolution, making indelible contributions to overthrowing monarchical absolutism and establishing a republic. Supporters argue that his Reign of Terror was a necessary measure to defend the revolution's achievements at a critical moment of national survival. His vision of a 'republic of virtue' reflected a noble pursuit of equality, liberty, and justice, profoundly influencing the development of democratic politics. Robespierre's commitment to principles and defiance of power made him a symbol of revolutionary idealism.

critic.zh: 批评者认为罗伯斯庇尔是法国大革命中最残暴的人物之一，他的恐怖统治导致了大量无辜生命的丧失，违背了革命所追求的自由与平等原则。他过度强调政治纯洁性，对异见者进行无情镇压，建立了极权统治的先例。罗伯斯庇尔的政策加剧了社会分裂，使革命从追求解放的工具变成了恐怖的机器。他的个人独断专行和权力欲望最终导致了他的倒台，也使革命理想蒙上了阴影。
critic.en: Critics consider Robespierre one of the most brutal figures of the French Revolution, as his Reign of Terror resulted in the loss of numerous innocent lives, contradicting the revolution's pursuit of liberty and equality. He excessively emphasized political purity, ruthlessly suppressed dissent, and established precedents for totalitarian rule. Robespierre's policies exacerbated social divisions, transforming the revolution from a tool for liberation into a machine of terror. His autocratic rule and hunger for power ultimately led to his downfall and tarnished the revolutionary ideals.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，罗伯斯庇尔被视为一个极其复杂的历史人物，既是理想主义的革命家，也是恐怖统治的象征。历史学家普遍认为他的政策是特定历史条件下的产物，反映了革命面临的内外危机。罗伯斯庇尔在流行文化中常被描绘为矛盾的统一体——既有崇高的政治理想，又有残酷的政治实践。他的形象反映了法国大革命的内在矛盾：追求自由与平等的理想与实施暴力的现实之间的张力。罗伯斯庇尔的遗产提醒人们，革命理想与现实政治之间的平衡是何等困难。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Robespierre is viewed as an extremely complex historical figure, both an idealistic revolutionary and a symbol of terror. Historians generally regard his policies as products of specific historical conditions, reflecting the internal and external crises faced by the revolution. In popular culture, Robespierre is often depicted as a paradoxical figure—possessing both lofty political ideals and implementing brutal political practices. His image reflects the inherent contradictions of the French Revolution: the tension between the pursuit of liberty and equality ideals and the reality of implementing violence. Robespierre's legacy reminds us of the difficulty of balancing revolutionary ideals with realpolitik.

self.zh: 在共和国中，美德是必不可少的，而恐怖则是它的守护者。
self.en: In the republic, virtue is necessary; but terror is at the same time its essential ingredient.

others.zh: 罗伯斯庇尔是历史上最纯粹的革命者之一，也是最可怕的暴君之一。他既无私又残忍，既崇高又卑鄙。
others.en: Robespierre was one of the purest revolutionaries in history and one of the most terrible tyrants. He was both selfless and cruel, both sublime and base.
